title: Pernil
subtitle: Puerto Rican slow-roasted pork shoulder with citrus and oregano
excerpt: Pork shoulder marinated overnight in garlic, citrus juice and oregano, then roasted low and slow until the meat falls apart and the skin crisps. This is a centrepiece dish. The long marinating time does most of the work.
sourceNotes: Pernil is a Puerto Rican celebration dish traditionally served at Christmas and New Year. The name comes from the Spanish word for leg, though shoulder is now more commonly used.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze the pulled meat without the skin. Reheat gently in a covered pan with a splash of stock.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate the night before. The longer it sits, the better the flavour penetrates.
recipe.temperatureNote: Fan 150°C / Gas 3 for the slow roast, then 220°C to crisp the skin

content.text: Score the skin deeply and push the marinade paste into the cuts. The flavour needs to reach the meat, not just sit on the surface.
Mix the garlic, oregano, cumin, paprika, olive oil, vinegar, orange juice and lime juice into a paste.
Score the pork skin deeply in a cross-hatch pattern. Push the paste into every cut and all over the surface.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours, or overnight.
Bring the pork to room temperature for 30 minutes before cooking.
Heat your oven to 170°C. Place the pork skin-side up in a roasting tin. Cover tightly with foil.
Roast for 2 hours 45 minutes. Remove the foil.
Raise the oven to 220°C. Roast uncovered for a further 30 minutes until the skin is golden and crackled.
Rest for 20 minutes before pulling apart. The meat should shred easily with two forks.

items.symptom: Skin is not crisp after 30 minutes at high heat.
items.cause: Skin was wet or still covered in marinade liquid.
items.fix: Pat skin dry before the high-heat blast.

items.symptom: Meat is not pulling apart after 3 hours.
items.cause: Oven temp was too low or the pork was very cold when it went in.
items.fix: Cover and return to oven for another 30 minutes at 170°C.

items.cause: Marinade did not penetrate deep enough.
items.fix: Score cuts deeper next time and marinate for the full overnight.
